title: Picou: independent tinsmith, jealous husband, still playing at 80
summary: Emile describes Picou as an independent tinsmith who made good money and was jealous of his midwife wife; he is still a good musician at about 80.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
